profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, USA, trading as NVDA. Its Nemotron page describes a family of highly efficient, multimodal, open AI models built for long-running, self-evolving agents. The company says Nemotron models deliver agentic reasoning for graduate-level science, advanced math, and visual understanding, and are designed for fast task completion with high reasoning throughput and leading accuracy for complex agent workflows. NVIDIA states that the models have transparent training data and broad platform support, including NVIDIA RTX PRO and NVIDIA DGX Spark, and are openly available from edge to cloud.

The company's AI products include NVIDIA Nemotron, an enterprise LLM family with synthetic data generation, GPU optimization, and self-hosted options, and NVIDIA NIM, inference microservices for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options. The site says Nemotron models are available as optimized NVIDIA NIM microservices, which require an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license for secure, scalable deployment, and can be tried or downloaded from build.nvidia.com. NVIDIA also describes Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for specialized tasks, NeMo Switchyard for routing, Nemotron Speech models for ASR, TTS, and NMT, and Nemotron Retriever models for document understanding and retrieval. The company positions Nemotron as open source under the NVIDIA Open Model License, which allows use, modification, distribution, and commercial deployment without crediting NVIDIA.

California legal exposure data lists 281 entries for NVIDIA. The company's last reported revenue was $215,938,000,000 for the fiscal period ended 2026-01-25, per its 10-K filing. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001045810.
